questions.question: 14 people can do work in 28 days. In how many days, can 8 people complete double the work?
questions.solution:
Given:

Men = 14

Time = 28 days

Formula used:

Work = Number of days (Time) (T or D) × Number of men (M). 

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

Calculation

Total work done by 14 people = 14 × 28

⇒ 392

Let the number of days by 8 men to do double the work be D2.

⇒ 392 × 2 = 8 × D2

⇒ D2 = 49 × 2

⇒ D2 = 98 days

**∴ Number of days required is 98.**

questions.question: A solid hemisphere of radius 8 cm is melted into N identical cone whose radius is 4 cm and height is 2 cm. Then, what is the value of N?
questions.solution:

Radius of cone = 4 cm

Height of cone = 2 cm

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3) × πr³

Volume of cone = (1/3) πR²h

Calculation:

The volume of the hemisphere = N × Volume of the cone

⇒ (2/3) × π (8)³ = N × (1/3) × π (4)² × 2

⇒ (2 × 512) = 32N

⇒ N = 32

∴ The value of N is 32.

questions.question: Five bells commence tolling together and toll at intervals of 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 seconds respectively. In 1 hour 20 minutes, how many times do they toll together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**LCM** of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 = 300 seconds.

Interval of tolling together = 300 ÷ 60 = 5 minutes.

Total time = 1 hour 20 minutes = 80 minutes.

Number of times = (Total time ÷ Interval) + 1 = (80 ÷ 5) + 1 = 16 + 1 = 17.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Intervals are 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25 seconds. Total duration is 1 hour 20 minutes.

**Formula Used:** Time interval for together tolling = **LCM** of individual intervals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be276615019a945f45a83116c7a38deacf256ccd9a431f5cd61fe6598e08eca1.png] 

⇒ **LCM** (5, 10, 15, 20, 25):

⇒ 5 = 5¹

⇒ 10 = 2 × 5

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 20 = 2² × 5

⇒ 25 = 5²

⇒ **LCM** = 2² × 3 × 5² = 4 × 3 × 25 = 300 seconds.

⇒ Interval in minutes = 300 ÷ 60 = 5 minutes.

⇒ Total time in minutes = (1 × 60) + 20 = 80 minutes.

⇒ Number of times = (80 ÷ 5) + 1 = 16 + 1 = 17 times.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

It is the smallest non-zero common number which is a multiple of all the given numbers.

Tolling Together Rule

For problems starting with 'commence tolling together', always add 1 to the quotient of (Total Time / LCM) to account for the first toll at 0 seconds.

Time Conversions

1 hour = 60 minutes = 3600 seconds. Always ensure units are consistent before performing division.</p

questions.question: A alone can do a work in 16 days and B alone can do the same work in 12 days. If they worked together on it for 4 days and then A left. How long did B take to finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B can do a piece of work in 16 and 12 days respectively.

Together they do that work together for 4 days, and then A leaves.

Concept used:

Entire work = Work done each day (in Units) × Total time taken (in days)

Calculation:

LCM (12,16) = 48

Let the total work be the LCM of 12 & 16.

So, the total work = 48 units

Now,

⇒ A does = 48 ÷ 16 = 3 units each day

⇒ B does = 48 ÷ 12 = 4 units each day

⇒ Together they do = (4 + 3) = 7 units each day

So, in 4 days, they completed = 7 × 4 = 28 units of work

⇒ Now, the remaining work = (48 - 28) = 20 units

⇒ B will complete the remaining work in = 20 ÷ 4 = 5 days

**∴ B will complete in 5 days. **

questions.question: The students in three classes are in a ratio of 3 ∶ 7 ∶ 8. If 6 students are increased in each class, the ratio changes to 11 ∶ 23 ∶ 26. Find the total number of students in the three classes before the increase.
questions.solution:
Given:

The students in the three classes are in the ratio 3 ∶ 7 ∶ 8.

If 6 students are increased in each class, the ratio of the student in three classes becomes 11 ∶ 23 ∶ 26.

Calculation:

Let the number of students in three classes be 3x, 7x and 8x respectively.

When the number of students is increased by 6 in each class,

Then the number of students in three classes will be 3x + 6, 7x + 6 and 8x + 6 respectively.

According to the question,

(3x + 6) ∶ (7x + 6) ∶ (8x + 6) = 11 ∶ 23 ∶ 26

⇒ (3x + 6) ∶ (7x + 6) = 11/23

⇒ (3x + 6) × 23 = (7x + 6) × 11

⇒ 77x – 69x = 138 - 66

⇒ 8x = 72

⇒ x = 9

The total number of students in the beginning = 3x + 7x + 8x = 18x

18x = 18 × 9 = 162

∴ Originally, the total number of students is 162.

questions.question: A speeding car traveling at 40 km/hr decides to slow down to 30 km/hr after covering half the distance. What is the average speed?
questions.solution:

Car speed = 40 km/hr

Car's speed after slowing down = 30 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance/total time

**Calculation**

Let the total distance be 2x km

Time is taken to cover half the distance at 40 km/hr = x / 40 hr

Time is taken to cover rest half distance at 30 km/hr = x / 30 hr

Total time taken = x / 40 + x / 30

⇒ (3x + 4x) / 120

⇒ 7x / 120

Average speed = 2x / (7x / 120)

⇒ 240/7 km/hr

**∴ The average speed is 240/7 km/hr.**

Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 6 + 16 - __**6 × 2**__

⇒ __**6 + 16**__ - 12

⇒ 22 - 12 = **10**

⇒ '84 ÷ 14 + 16 - 6 × 2 = 10'

Here, the equation is** satisfied.**

**(2) 2 and 84**

⇒ 84 ÷ 6 + 16 - 14 × 2 = 10

⇒ __**2 ÷ 6**__ + 16 - 14 × 84 = 10

⇒ 0.33 + 16 - __**14 × 84**__

⇒ 0.33 + 16 - 1176

⇒ (-1159.67)

⇒ '2 ÷ 6 + 16 - 14 × 84 = (-1159.67)'

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

**(3) 10 and 14**

⇒ 84 ÷ 6 + 16 - 14 × 2 = 10

After interchanging:

⇒ __**84 ÷ 6**__ + 16 - 10 × 2 = 14

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 14 + 16 - __**10 × 2**__

⇒ __**14 + 16**__ - 20

⇒ 30 - 20 = 10

⇒ '84 ÷ 6 + 16 - 10 × 2 = 10'

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

**(4) 6 and 10**

⇒ __**8.4 + 16**__ - 28

⇒ 24.4 - 28 = (-3.6)

⇒ '84 ÷ 10 + 16 - 14 × 2 = (-3.6)'

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
